0022600215.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-9, on a three-game losing streak and 0-5 at home) host the Orlando Magic (2-7, on a four-game losing streak) in the Kings' 11th game of the season, with Sacramento 14th in the West and Orlando 12th in the East. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain), and Tristan da Silva is day-to-day with a calf strain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Kings lost both games to the Magic in 2025-26, most recently 121-117 in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
